text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — planning to flip the console UI exposure flag for the 'Advanced settings' beta. Want to confirm canary audience + guardrails before I create the PR. Target: internal devs + selected customers, then gradual ramp. Any objections?

Joel Park: I think start internal-only (eng + SE) for 24–48h, then a small external canary (5%) for partner customers. Scope by workspace_id allowlist. Recommended phases: internal -> invited customers -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Add an explicit kill-switch and automated rollback thresholds.

Rhea Singh: Agree. What telemetry should we watch? My shortlist: Sentry error count for the settings UI, p95 settings-load latency, and new support tickets mentioning "advanced settings". Suggest automatic rollback if Sentry error rate >1.5x baseline for 10m or p95 latency >500ms.

Alex B: I raised a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-console/pull/5423 — includes server-side flag wiring + guardrail hooks. Needs review, cc @Maya. Small rollout config snippet included below for reference:

```json
{
  "flag_key": "console.advanced_settings.v1",
  "default": false,
  "rules": [
    {"audience": "internal", "percent": 100},
    {"audience": "external_canary", "percent": 5}
  ],
  "kill_switch": true
}
```

Maya Chen: For audiences, can we use `user_tag: beta_opt_in` for SE + partner customers? Also make the UI entry hidden unless `console.flags.debug=true` so it doesn't show in normal prod UX.

Joel Park: Good call. Also wire in a lightweight notification (SE slack thread) when a customer in the invited cohort enables it, and mark the experiment label `experiment: advanced_settings_beta` for analytics.

deploy-bot: feature-flag-service: flag `console.advanced_settings.v1` created in staging by Maya Chen at 1759801350 :white_check_mark:

Rhea Singh: Who's owning the rollout comms & support playbook? We should include a short blurb for release notes + quick triage steps for support. @Product PM?

Maya Chen: I can draft the release note + support doc. Proposed rollout timeline: internal-only for 48h, then invited customers for 1 week, then 10% ramping (double percent twice daily) to 100% if all metrics stay green. Rollback triggers: Sentry >1.5x, p95 >500ms, or >3 support tickets in 1h.

Joel Park: LGTM; left a tiny nit in the PR about guardrail naming but otherwise looks good. :thumbsup:

Alex B: Merged the PR into staging. Will schedule the staging -> canary toggle tomorrow 09:00 PT and post when toggled. cc: @ops

Maya Chen: Thanks — I'll post the canary start message and checklist in #eng-oncall. I'll also add an eval prompt set to compare help text outputs before/after (Rhea's suggestion).

Rhea Singh: Perfect. Also please ensure the audit logs capture who toggles the flag and the exact rollout percentage changes.

Maya Chen: Yep — audit log hooks are included in the PR. I'll follow up with a short checklist and the support playbook link once it's ready. Thanks all!
